Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You point your weapon at your quarry, speak the promise that brought you here, and strike as you step into their path.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One adjacent creature.
Duration
Damage and movement are immediate; the quarry mark lasts until the end of your next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Tell them why you came as you make a melee attack. Your certainty, not your strength, guides the strike.

Weak
3 physical damage.
Standard
3 physical damage; mark it as your quarry until the end of your next turn.
Strong
5 physical damage; mark it and move 1 square toward it without provoking.
